description:
PipCount keeps game night moving. Set up a table in seconds, add your crew, and score every round without passing around a notes app or doing score math by hand.

Choose from a classic scoreboard, ten-stage card-game scoring, or a dinner-themed scoring mode. Reuse saved players, undo the last round, and use built-in timer, dice, and starter tools when the table needs them.

When the game is over, PipCount saves the final scores, game history, player stats, and head-to-head results so every game night becomes part of your record. You can share a scorecard image through the system share sheet if you choose.

Your first 25 games are free. A one-time purchase unlocks unlimited games with no subscription.
